HELP_TEXT:
🧭 Cultivation Guide:
1️⃣ Start AFK meditation to gather Qi.
2️⃣ When your Dantian is full, attempt a breakthrough and endure seclusion.
3️⃣ Multiply your speed with spirit stones, pills and spirit veins.
4️⃣ At the end of Qi Condensation, choose your Dao path and alignment.
5️⃣ Conquer zones, found a sect, and ascend to Dao Sovereign!
